subject: DI04005011

body.en:
Definition

A pesticide is a substance/mixture intended to prevent,destroy,repel or control a pest,including specified vectors or unwanted organisms according to applicable regulation.It is defined by intended function and legal product specification,not merely by being poisonous.

Classification first

By target:insecticides,herbicides,fungicides,rodenticides,nematicides and acaricides.By action/placement:contact,systemic,stomach poisons and fumigants;categories may overlap.By chemistry:inorganic,botanical,organochlorine,organophosphorus,carbamate,pyrethroid and other classes;biological products are another important group.Classification does not establish safety or authorisation.

Risk and product identity

Hazard,persistence,exposure,selectivity and legal approval must all be assessed.Active ingredient and formulated product are different;salts/esters/isomer mixtures are not interchangeable without specification.Historical syllabus products are discussed to understand chemistry and environmental consequences,not as present-use recommendations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Pest,ચોક્કસ vectors/unwanted organismsને prevent,destroy,repel/control કરવા intended substance/mixture pesticide છે;applicable regulation લાગુ પડે છે. Intended function/legal specification મહત્વનાં છે,ફક્ત poisonous હોવું વ્યાખ્યા નથી.

વર્ગીકરણ

Target મુજબ insecticides,herbicides,fungicides,rodenticides,nematicides તથા acaricides. Action/placement મુજબ contact,systemic,stomach poisons તથા fumigants;categories overlap થઈ શકે છે. Chemistry મુજબ inorganic,botanical,organochlorine,organophosphorus,carbamate,pyrethroid/other classes;biological products પણ મહત્વનાં છે. Classification safety/authorisation સાબિત કરતું નથી.

Risk તથા Product Identity

Hazard,persistence,exposure,selectivity તથા legal approvalનું assessment કરવું. Active ingredient તથા formulation અલગ છે;salts/esters/isomer mixtures specification વગર interchangeable નથી. Historical syllabus products chemistry/environmental effects માટે છે,present-use recommendation માટે નહીં.

body.en:
Definition and classification

A formulation combines active ingredient with approved auxiliaries to give specified handling,storage and delivery properties.Dry types:DP dust,WP wettable powder,GR granule,WG water-dispersible granule.Liquid types:EC emulsifiable concentrate,SC suspension concentrate,SL soluble concentrate and EW oil-in-water emulsion.WP forms a suspension,not a true molecular solution;EC emulsifies in its approved dilution system.

Components and quality

Carriers,diluents,solvents,wetters,dispersants,emulsifiers,stabilisers and antifoams have different roles;not every formulation uses all of them.Check active content,particle size,suspensibility/wettability,emulsion stability,pH,storage stability and packaging as relevant.No active percentage,field dose or unauthorised mixing recipe is supplied.Incompatible mixing can increase exposure or spoil performance.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા વર્ગીકરણ

Active ingredientને approved auxiliaries સાથે મેળવી specified handling,storage/delivery properties આપવી એટલે formulation. Dry types:DP dust,WP wettable powder,GR granule,WG water-dispersible granule. Liquid types:EC emulsifiable concentrate,SC suspension concentrate,SL soluble concentrate તથા EW oil-in-water emulsion. WP suspension બનાવે છે,true molecular solution નહીં;EC approved dilution systemમાં emulsify થાય છે.

Components તથા Quality

Carriers,diluents,solvents,wetters,dispersants,emulsifiers,stabilisers/antifoamsના roles જુદા છે;બધાં દરેક formulationમાં નથી. Active content,particle size,suspensibility/wettability,emulsion stability,pH,storage stability તથા packing relevant હોય તે તપાસો. Active percentage,field dose/unauthorised mixing recipe આપેલ નથી. Incompatible mixingથી exposure/performance બગડે છે.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

A wettable powder is a dry formulation designed to wet/disperse in the approved liquid and suspend the active particles.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Authorised active ingredient,inert carrier and approved wetting/dispersing aids under a registered specification.

Physical blending/particle processing;not synthesis of a new active ingredient.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Specification and contained solid handling

Authorisation/specification review precedes any processing.Closed weighing/transfer keeps active dust from workers and surroundings.Carrier/active blending and suitable milling produce the intended dispersion/particle distribution;the equipment must be selected for material compatibility and dust control.

2. Auxiliary blending,testing and packing

Approved wetting/dispersing aids are blended uniformly.Quality control verifies composition and relevant physical behaviour before authorised labelled packing.Containment/cleaning prevent cross-contamination with other products.Classroom practice should use the approved harmless surrogate instead of real hazardous active material.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control dust,milling heat,segregation,contamination,packaging integrity and waste;no agricultural dosage advice.

Properties / applications

Authorised formulation manufacturing concept only;other formulation types need different equipment and tests.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

Approved liquidમાં wet/disperse થઈ active particles suspend કરવા બનાવેલું dry formulation wettable powder છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Registered specification હેઠળ authorised active ingredient,inert carrier તથા approved wetting/dispersing aids.

Physical blending/particle processing;not synthesis of a new active ingredient.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Specification તથા Contained Solid Handling

Processing પહેલાં authorisation/specification review થાય છે. Closed weighing/transfer active dustથી workers/environmentને બચાવે છે. Carrier/active blending तथा suitable milling intended dispersion/particle distribution આપે છે;compatibility/dust control મુજબ equipment જોઈએ.

2. Auxiliary Blending,Testing તથા Packing

Approved wetting/dispersing aids uniform blend થાય છે. Authorised labelled packing પહેલાં composition/physical behaviour તપાસાય છે. Containment/cleaning cross-contamination રોકે છે. Classroom practiceમાં hazardous activeને બદલે approved harmless surrogate વાપરવો.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Dust,milling heat,segregation,contamination,packing/waste નિયંત્રિત કરવા;agricultural dosage advice નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

ફક્ત authorised formulation-manufacturing concept;other typesમાં જુદાં equipment/tests જોઈએ.

Definition and selected route

Methyl bromide(bromomethane,CH3Br) is a highly hazardous volatile fumigant covered here as a historical/regulated industrial product.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Representative historical feed is methanol with an authorised hydrogen-bromide system;engineered gas capture is essential.No reagent charges,conditions or hands-on procedure are provided.

CH3OH + HBr → CH3Br + H2O(overall chemistry only;no operational synthesis procedure).

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Enclosed manufacturing functions

Authorised feed handling supplies an enclosed reaction section that forms bromomethane.The closed purification train separates unwanted gas/liquid components,followed by qualified condensation/containment and specification checks.The diagram labels industrial duties rather than supplying a working recipe for a toxic gas.

2. Containment and environmental context

Captured off-gas/residues require dedicated treatment and authorised storage/transport.Methyl bromide depletes stratospheric ozone.Controlled non-QPS uses are subject to Montreal Protocol phase-out controls;quarantine/pre-shipment(QPS) is a specific exemption category,not blanket permission for anyone to fumigate.National authorisation and alternatives still matter.

Engineering and quality considerations

Acute toxic-gas risk,leak detection,containment,emission minimisation and licensed personnel dominate the process.No matching owner sheet exists.

Properties / applications

Historical and specifically authorised fumigation context only;no application,dose or self-handling guidance.

1. Enclosed Manufacturing Functions

Authorised feed handling enclosed reaction sectionમાં feed આપે છે,જ્યાં bromomethane બને છે. Closed purification unwanted gas/liquid components જુદાં કરે છે;પછી qualified condensation/containment તથા specification checks થાય છે. Diagram industrial duties બતાવે છે,toxic gasની working recipe નહીં.

National authorisation/alternatives મહત્વનાં છે.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Acute toxic-gas risk,leak detection,containment,emission minimisation તથા licensed personnel મહત્વનાં છે;matching owner sheet નથી.

ફક્ત historical તથા specifically authorised fumigation context;application,dose/self-handling guidance નથી.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

2,4-D is 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid,a phenoxy herbicide active whose acid,salt and ester forms have distinct specifications.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Licensed 2,4-dichlorophenol/chloroacetate-base chemistry in a closed industrial system.

Formal overall relationship:Cl2C6H3OH + ClCH2COOH → Cl2C6H3OCH2COOH + HCl.Industrial base-assisted processing forms salts before acid-form isolation;charges/conditions are deliberately omitted.

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Phenoxyacetate formation

The industrial reaction couples the specified chlorophenoxy group with an acetate side chain through an ether linkage.Controlled work-up separates the intended phenoxyacetate-containing stream from salt-rich aqueous residues.The target is 2,4-substitution;different chlorophenol impurities cannot be ignored because a generic herbicide name was obtained.

2. Product isolation and qualification

Acid-form isolation,purification and drying produce the specified herbicide active material;it is not a pharmaceutical API.Regulated qualification controls identity,impurities and release.Formulation into a particular salt/ester product is a separate authorised stage,not an interchangeable label for acid crystals.

Engineering and quality considerations

Control chlorophenol impurities,worker exposure,closed handling,salt/organic effluent and product/formulation identity;no operating recipe is supplied.

Properties / applications

Authorised selective-herbicide products only under applicable product approval;no field-use recommendations.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

2,4-D એટલે 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid phenoxy herbicide active;acid,salt તથા ester formsની specifications જુદી છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Closed industrial systemમાં licensed 2,4-dichlorophenol/chloroacetate-base chemistry.

Formal overall relationship:Cl2C6H3OH + ClCH2COOH → Cl2C6H3OCH2COOH + HCl.Industrial base-assisted processing forms salts before acid-form isolation;charges/conditions are deliberately omitted.

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Phenoxyacetate Formation

Industrial reactionમાં specified chlorophenoxy group ether linkageથી acetate side chain સાથે જોડાય છે. Controlled work-up intended phenoxyacetate-containing streamને salt-rich aqueous residuesથી જુદું કરે છે. Target 2,4-substitution છે;generic herbicide નામ મળ્યું એટલે other chlorophenol impurities અવગણવા નહીં.

2. Product Isolation તથા Qualification

Acid-form isolation,purification/dryingથી specified active material મળે છે;તે pharmaceutical API નથી. Regulated qualificationમાં identity,impurities/release નિયંત્રિત થાય છે. Particular salt/ester formulation અલગ authorised stage છે;acid crystalsનો interchangeable label નહીં.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Chlorophenol impurities,worker exposure,closed handling,salt/organic effluent તથા product identity નિયંત્રિત કરવા;synthesis recipe નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Applicable approval મુજબ authorised selective-herbicide products;field-use recommendation નથી.

notes.reaction: Formal overall relationship:Cl2C6H3OH + ClCH2COOH → Cl2C6H3OCH2COOH + HCl.Industrial base-assisted processing forms salts before acid-form isolation;charges/conditions are deliberately omitted.

body.en:
Definition and selected route

BHC is the historical name benzene hexachloride for hexachlorocyclohexane(HCH),an isomer mixture;it is not hexachlorobenzene.Lindane is the gamma-HCH isomer.

Raw materials and chemical principle

Historical closed benzene/chlorine photochemical-addition chemistry;not an approved classroom synthesis.

C6H6 + 3Cl2 → C6H6Cl6(historical addition chemistry;no operating recipe).

Complete labelled study flowsheet

1. Historical addition and isomer mixture

The historical process adds chlorine to the benzene ring through an engineered photochemical section rather than simply substituting every ring hydrogen.Technical HCH contains multiple stereoisomers;the entire mixture is not lindane.Isolation and historical separation sought a desired isomer fraction butalso generated substantial non-product persistent residues.

2. Persistent-waste and elimination context

Alpha-HCH,beta-HCH and lindane are listed under AnnexA of the Stockholm Convention for elimination,with exemptions only where applicable and registered.Historical stockpiles/isomer wastes need authorised persistent-organic-pollutant management.This overview does not assert a specific current Indian licence status or recommend manufacture/use.

Engineering and quality considerations

Persistent toxic isomer waste,benzene/chlorine hazards and regulatory elimination make this academic process mapping only.No charges,conditions,separation recipe or application dose.

Properties / applications

Historical insecticide chemistry/environmental case study,not a present-use recommendation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા તથા પસંદ કરેલી Route

BHC historical benzene hexachloride નામવાળું hexachlorocyclohexane(HCH) isomer mixture છે;hexachlorobenzene નથી. Lindane gamma-HCH isomer છે.

કાચો માલ તથા રાસાયણિક સિદ્ધાંત

Historical closed benzene/chlorine photochemical-addition chemistry;approved classroom synthesis નથી.

C6H6 + 3Cl2 → C6H6Cl6(historical addition chemistry;no operating recipe).

સંપૂર્ણ Labelled Study Flowsheet

1. Historical Addition તથા Isomer Mixture

Historical process engineered photochemical sectionમાં benzene ring પર chlorine add કરે છે,દરેક hydrogen substitute નથી કરતું. Technical HCHમાં અનેક stereoisomers છે;સમગ્ર mixture lindane નથી. Historical separationથી desired fraction સાથે ઘણાં non-product persistent residues પણ બનતાં હતાં.

2. Persistent-waste તથા Elimination Context

Alpha-HCH,beta-HCH તથા lindane Stockholm Conventionના AnnexAમાં elimination માટે listed છે;applicable/registered હોય ત્યાં જ exemptions. Historical stockpiles/isomer wastes માટે authorised POP management જોઈએ. આ overview ચોક્કસ current Indian licence statusનો દાવો કે manufacture/useની ભલામણ કરતું નથી.

Engineering તથા Quality બાબતો

Persistent toxic isomer waste,benzene/chlorine hazards તથા regulatory eliminationને કારણે ફક્ત academic mapping;charges,conditions,separation recipe/application dose નથી.

ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Historical insecticide chemistry/environmental case study;present-use recommendation નહીં.

h.en: Study pesticide formulation with a harmless surrogate

body.en:
Aim

Study pesticide formulation with a harmless surrogate

Principle

Formulation combines active/carrier/auxiliaries;use an approved non-active surrogate for the classroom physical-dispersion study.

Apparatus/materials

Teacher-approved harmless surrogate/carrier,closed mixer,sieves,balance and dispersion-test vessels;no toxic active.

Supervised procedure / record

Record that the material is a surrogate,not pesticide.Weigh only instructor-assigned safe materials,blend with containment and examine uniformity,wetting/dispersion or settling by the approved method.Compare WP/suspension/emulsion concepts without preparing hazardous fumigants or actual restricted pesticides.

Blank observations—actual experiment required

Surrogate identity/approval:____;masses(g):____;uniformity:____;wetting/settling observations:____

Calculations and result

Surrogate component mass fraction=component mass/total blend mass;this is not an authorised active concentration or field dose.

Result:____;units:____;SOP/reference:____.No experiment/readings/results have been fabricated.

Precautions and waste

Prevent dust/incompatible mixing;label NOT A PESTICIDE and dispose by the safe teaching SOP.

Syllabus cross-reference correction

The practical table prints Unit7;the actual theory belongs to Unit6.The official practical number is preserved.

q.en: Explain the principle of Pesticide formulation—wettable powder example.
q.gu: Pesticide Formulation—Wettable Powder Exampleનો સિદ્ધાંત સમજાવો.

a.en: A wettable powder is a dry formulation designed to wet/disperse in the approved liquid and suspend the active particles. Authorised active ingredient,inert carrier and approved wetting/dispersing aids under a registered specification.
a.gu: Approved liquidમાં wet/disperse થઈ active particles suspend કરવા બનાવેલું dry formulation wettable powder છે. Registered specification હેઠળ authorised active ingredient,inert carrier તથા approved wetting/dispersing aids.

q.en: Explain the principle of Methyl bromide—historical process overview.
q.gu: Methyl Bromide—Historical Process Overviewનો સિદ્ધાંત સમજાવો.

a.en: Methyl bromide(bromomethane,CH3Br) is a highly hazardous volatile fumigant covered here as a historical/regulated industrial product. Representative historical feed is methanol with an authorised hydrogen-bromide system;engineered gas capture is essential.No reagent charges,conditions or hands-on procedure are provided.
a.gu: Methyl bromide(bromomethane,CH3Br) highly hazardous volatile fumigant છે;અહીં historical/regulated industrial product તરીકે અભ્યાસ છે. Representative historical feed methanol તથા authorised hydrogen-bromide system છે;engineered gas capture જરૂરી. Reagent charges,conditions/hands-on procedure આપેલ નથી.

a.en: 2,4-D is 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid,a phenoxy herbicide active whose acid,salt and ester forms have distinct specifications. Licensed 2,4-dichlorophenol/chloroacetate-base chemistry in a closed industrial system.
a.gu: 2,4-D એટલે 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetic acid phenoxy herbicide active;acid,salt તથા ester formsની specifications જુદી છે. Closed industrial systemમાં licensed 2,4-dichlorophenol/chloroacetate-base chemistry.

q.en: Explain the principle of BHC/HCH—historical process overview.

a.en: BHC is the historical name benzene hexachloride for hexachlorocyclohexane(HCH),an isomer mixture;it is not hexachlorobenzene.Lindane is the gamma-HCH isomer. Historical closed benzene/chlorine photochemical-addition chemistry;not an approved classroom synthesis.
a.gu: BHC historical benzene hexachloride નામવાળું hexachlorocyclohexane(HCH) isomer mixture છે;hexachlorobenzene નથી. Lindane gamma-HCH isomer છે. Historical closed benzene/chlorine photochemical-addition chemistry;approved classroom synthesis નથી.
